video_title: Jamal Shead | Post Game vs Magic | October 28, 2026

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on his offensive role and shooting confidence
quotes.excerpt: I haven't shot the ball much this season yet, so today was the first day I was looking
quotes.quote: I haven't shot the ball much this season yet, so today was the first day I was looking for my shot a little more. It felt good for it to go in.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead says he was looking for his shot more against the Magic and it felt good to see the ball go in.

structured.context: Jamal Shead discusses his offensive performance and confidence in his shooting during his post-game media availability.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on his responsibility to score for the team
quotes.excerpt: offensively I'm a liability if I don't look for my shot
quotes.quote: Offensively I'm a liability if I don't look for my shot. I think that I do a great job of getting guys involved, but if they're just not going to help, I have to go score the ball.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead admits he is an offensive liability if he does not look for his own shot. He says he has to score when defenses stop helping off him.

structured.context: Jamal Shead explains his mindset regarding his responsibility to score to prevent being a liability on offense.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the second unit's chemistry and performance
quotes.excerpt: we've worked all summer together and we've had a couple of games under our belt now
quotes.quote: The first unit started off a little slow. I think the second unit we just played to the standard. I wouldn't say that it was different. We've worked all summer together and we've had a couple of games under our belt now, so we're getting used to each other. We just played to our standard, tried to turn them over a little bit more, and we made our shots.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead credits the Raptors second unit for playing to their standard and finding chemistry after working together all summer.

structured.context: Jamal Shead reflects on the chemistry and performance of the second unit during the game against the Magic.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the potential of playing alongside Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: we kind of have to do that more with Kawhi, and that'll make us better
quotes.quote: We kind of have to do that more with Kawhi, and that'll make us better. I think once he comes back, and if we're still clicking and playing like this in the second unit, it doesn't do anything but make us better.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead believes the Raptors will be even better once Kawhi Leonard returns to the lineup.

structured.context: Jamal Shead discusses how the team will improve once Kawhi Leonard returns to the lineup.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on RJ Barrett's paint finishing and craft
quotes.excerpt: his paint finishing and his paint touch and him getting downhill is a real expertise of his craft
quotes.quote: His paint finishing and his paint touch and him getting downhill is a real expertise of his craft. I think people don't realize how hard it is to stay in front of and until you get out of there and you got to guard him. It's a great outlet for our offense and I think he stepped up big time today.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead praises RJ Barrett for his ability to get downhill and finish in the paint calling it a real expertise of his craft.

structured.context: Jamal Shead praises RJ Barrett for his ability to finish in the paint and his impact on the team's offense.
